definitions.reference: Unmodified FAST separate 10000 steps, same seed and scalar output
definitions.primary: All 74 metrics: original 10; 15 integrands x (1,4,32-frame means and EMA); 4 held-out filter-width aggregates
definitions.phase: RMSE against known integral, all 32 starting phases, cycle shift y/x=(-71,-37), wrapped sigma1 Gaussian radius3
definitions.ema: alpha .1; four cycles from per-pixel volume mean; RMS over last cycle and all start phases; same shifted playback
definitions.dominance: Pointwise strictly lower in every primary metric for both seeds; no averaging away regressions. Empirical suite, not universal claim.
definitions.bias: Phase-dependent spatial mean error RMS recorded separately, already included in primary RMSE
